# Samuel Kimama — Staff Frontend Engineer

Samuel Kimama is a Staff Frontend Engineer with 16+ years of experience leading architecture across product, platform, and design boundaries. He builds resilient frontend systems, defines scalable engineering patterns, and aligns cross-functional teams to ship complex products faster with higher quality — known for creating organizational leverage through standards, mentoring, and technical direction.

Open to roles. Targeting remote Staff frontend roles with broad product and platform ownership.

## About

My work sits where product complexity, team scale, and frontend architecture collide. I'm the engineer companies call when they need stronger foundations: clear component models, reliable API contracts, and patterns that hold up as teams grow.

Across SaaS platforms, enterprise modernization, ML-enabled products, and high-scale consumer systems, I work beyond feature delivery. I define architecture, align with backend and product partners, raise quality standards, and make the frontend a capable, first-class layer.

The throughline is leverage. Strong systems compound — reducing friction for users and drag for engineers, and making future product bets easier to execute.

## Core strengths

- Frontend Architecture & UI Systems
- Cross-Functional Leadership (Product, ML, Backend)
- Developer Productivity & Platform Leverage
- Performance, A11y, and Quality at Scale
- Design Systems & Scalable Component Models

## Experience

**Senior Software Engineer — WITNESS AI (Jan 2023 – Jan 2026)**
First UI engineer, responsible for establishing frontend architecture and enabling cross-team delivery for a rapidly evolving SaaS platform. Established the frontend architecture (React + TypeScript), defining component systems, API contracts, and patterns adopted across the product. Designed, implemented, and documented a company-wide RBAC system. Led integration of enterprise SSO (WorkOS). Patent issued: US 12,587,529 B2 — Real-time security for AI interactions (proxy-injected, real-time policy enforcement on AI input/output). Issued Mar 2026.

**Senior Software Engineer — Southwest Airlines (Jun 2022 – May 2023)**
Staff-level contributor on a large-scale modernization initiative migrating critical systems to a cloud-native architecture. Led frontend decomposition of a legacy monolith into micro-frontends (Single-SPA). Built a GraphQL/BFF layer transforming legacy APIs into UI-optimized read models.

**Lead Frontend Engineer — Confidential Client, NDA (Mar 2021 – Sep 2022)**
Principal frontend engineer for a multi-application platform integrating ML-driven workflows. Defined frontend architecture for a React + TypeScript mono-repo. Established frontend standards for A11y, analytics, performance, and testing.

**Lead Frontend Engineer — Survata (Jun 2015 – Apr 2020)**
First frontend engineer, later de facto frontend lead for a B2B SaaS analytics platform. Architected frontend systems across an AngularJS to React migration. Built a data visualization platform (D3-based plugin system). 67% TTFB reduction for return visitors.

**Senior Software Engineer — LinkedIn (Mar 2012 – Oct 2014)**
Led development of login and authentication flows used across web and mobile web at LinkedIn scale.
